mapper.sql: FROM biz_appoint_info r LEFT JOIN biz_queue q ON q.id = ( SELECT MAX(q2.id) FROM biz_queue q2 WHERE q2.regist_id = r.id AND q2.del_flag = 0 ) WHERE r.del_flag = 0

CASE WHEN q.id IS NOT NULL AND q.queue_status IN (2, 3, 4, 5, 6) THEN q.queue_status WHEN q.id IS NOT NULL AND q.queue_status = 7 THEN 7 WHEN q.id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.regist_status = 8 THEN 7 WHEN r.regist_status = 7 THEN 8 WHEN r.regist_status = 6 THEN 6 WHEN r.regist_status = 5 THEN 5 WHEN r.regist_status = 4 THEN 4 WHEN r.regist_status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN r.regist_status = 2 THEN 1 WHEN r.regist_status = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN r.charge_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) ELSE NULL END

if.test: q.deptId != null or (q.deptIds != null and q.deptIds.size() > 0)

sql.if: AND (r.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.regist_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.patient_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR q.queue_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.medical_insurance_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT r.id AS regist_id, r.regist_no, r.visit_date, r.regist_time, r.regist_status, (r.charge_id IS NOT NULL) AS charged, r.patient_id, r.patient_no, r.patient_name, r.gender, r.age, r.dept_id, r.dept_name, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.doctor_id, r.doctor_name, r.regist_type, r.regist_source, r.slot_time, r.settlement_type, r.medical_insurance_type,
r.visit_type AS revisit_type, q.id AS queue_id, q.queue_no, q.queue_status, q.queue_type, q.sequence_no, q.call_count, q.call_time, q.arrive_time, q.start_time, q.end_time, q.is_overdue, q.overdue_time, q.overdue_reason, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, q.arrive_time, q.start_time) AS wait_minutes, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, q.start_time, q.end_time) AS visit_minutes, AS log_status
) t
ORDER BY t.visit_date DESC, t.arrive_time DESC, t.regist_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wait_check_in, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consulting, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unvisited, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_show, SUM(CASE WHEN t.log_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unrecognized, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.arrive_time, t.start_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 720 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.arrive_time, t.start_time) END)) AS avg_wait_minutes, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.start_time, t.end_time) BETWEEN 1 AND 720 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.start_time, t.end_time) END)) AS avg_visit_minutes FROM ( SELECT AS log_status, q.arrive_time, q.start_time, q.end_time
) t
